title: Project Harbor: IC update
subtitle: Mid-market LBO, Investment Committee update #2
note: All figures are synthetic and illustrative.

slides.title: Harbor clears our 20% IRR hurdle at 11.0x entry, with 79% of EBITDA growth from price and savings
bullets: Entry at $1,056m EV (11.0x FY25E EBITDA of $96.0m), 5.5x senior plus 1.0x second lien
Base case returns 22.4% gross IRR and 2.8x MOIC over a five-year hold
FY25E EBITDA grows 17% to $96.0m: price +$6.0m and cost savings +$5.0m outweigh input costs of -$4.5m
Two diligence items remain open: top-3 customer renewals and the Q4 pricing pass-through
We ask IC to approve submission of a final bid at up to $1,090m EV

slides.title: LTM performance supports the plan: revenue +11%, EBITDA margin up 150 bps to 17.1%
slides.takeaway: Growth is price-led; volume contributes $9.5m, below the 3-year average of $11.2m.

slides.title: EBITDA grows $14.0m to $96.0m as price and savings more than offset input-cost inflation
callouts: Price realisation of 2.1% is in line with contracted escalators

slides.title: Returns hold above 20% IRR across entry multiples of 10.5x to 11.5x and exit of 10.0x to 12.0x
slides.caption: Gross IRR sensitivity
slides.takeaway: Only the 11.5x entry with a 10.0x exit falls below the 20% hurdle.
slides.source: Sponsor model v14, base operating case

slides.title: Four risks remain; two need confirmatory diligence before final bid
rows: Rollover of 40% of proceeds, MIP at 8%
